records.sql: BEGIN
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chancy_schema_version" ( version_of VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, version INT )
SELECT version FROM "chancy_schema_version" WHERE version_of = %s

CREATE TABLE "chancy_jobs" ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, queue TEXT NOT NULL, func TEXT NOT NULL, kwargs JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', limits JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', meta JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', state VARCHAR (25) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', priority INTEGER DEFAULT 0, attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0, max_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 1, taken_by TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), started_at TIMESTAMPTZ, completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, scheduled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), unique_key TEXT, errors JSON NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "chancy_jobs_unique_key" ON "chancy_jobs" (unique_key) WHERE unique_key IS NOT NULL AND state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed');

CREATE UNLOGGED TABLE "chancy_leader" ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, worker_id TEXT NOT NULL, first_seen TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL ); ALTER TABLE "chancy_leader" ADD CONSTRAINT "chancy_leader_worker_id_unique" UNIQUE (worker_id);

CREATE UNLOGGED TABLE "chancy_workers" ( -- The UUID of the worker. worker_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, -- The tags associated with this worker. tags TEXT[], -- The queues this worker is currently processing. queues TEXT[], last_seen TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL );
CREATE UNLOGGED TABLE "chancy_queue_rate_limits" ( queue VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, window_start INTEGER NOT NULL, count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 );

CREATE TABLE "chancy_queues" ( -- A unique name for the queue. name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, -- The state of the queue. This can be used to pause -- processing of jobs in the queue. state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', -- The number of jobs that can be processed concurrently -- per worker. concurrency INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- Only worker's matching these tags will be able to -- process jobs from this queue, or None for all workers. tags TEXT[], -- The executor to use for processing jobs in this queue. executor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chancy.executors.process.ProcessExecutor', -- Options to pass to the executor. executor_options JSON, -- The interval at which the queue should be polled for -- jobs. polling_interval INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- The time at which the queue was first declared. created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), -- The number of jobs that can be processed per period. rate_limit INTEGER, -- The period of time over which the rate limit applies. rate_limit_window INTEGER );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chancy_schema_version" ( version_of VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, version INT )
INSERT INTO "chancy_schema_version" (version_of, version) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT (version_of) DO UPDATE SET version = EXCLUDED.version
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "chancy_idx_jobs_queue_state" ON "chancy_jobs" (queue, state);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "chancy_idx_jobs_fetch_prune" ON "chancy_jobs" (queue, state, attempts, scheduled_at, priority DESC, id DESC) WHERE state IN ('pending', 'retrying');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chancy_schema_version" ( version_of VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, version INT )
INSERT INTO "chancy_schema_version" (version_of, version) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT (version_of) DO UPDATE SET version = EXCLUDED.version
UPDATE "chancy_jobs" SET max_attempts = 1 WHERE max_attempts IS NULL
ALTER TABLE "chancy_jobs" ALTER COLUMN max_attempts SET NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN max_attempts SET DEFAULT 1

INSERT INTO "chancy_queues" ( name, state, concurrency, tags, executor, executor_options, polling_interval, rate_limit, rate_limit_window, resume_at, eager_polling ) VALUES ( %(name)s, %(state)s, %(concurrency)s, %(tags)s, %(executor)s, %(executor_options)s, %(polling_interval)s, %(rate_limit)s, %(rate_limit_window)s, %(resume_at)s, %(eager_polling)s ) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name RETURNING state, concurrency, tags, polling_interval, executor, executor_options, rate_limit, rate_limit_window, resume_at, eager_polling
COMMIT

INSERT INTO "chancy_jobs" ( id, queue, func, kwargs, limits, meta, priority, max_attempts, scheduled_at, unique_key ) VALUES ( %(id)s, %(queue)s, %(func)s, %(kwargs)s, %(limits)s, %(meta)s, %(priority)s, %(max_attempts)s, %(scheduled_at)s, %(unique_key)s ) ON CONFLICT (unique_key) WHERE unique_key IS NOT NULL AND state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed') DO UPDATE SET state = "chancy_jobs".state RETURNING id;
COMMIT

INSERT INTO "chancy_jobs" ( id, queue, func, kwargs, limits, meta, priority, max_attempts, scheduled_at, unique_key ) VALUES ( %(id)s, %(queue)s, %(func)s, %(kwargs)s, %(limits)s, %(meta)s, %(priority)s, %(max_attempts)s, %(scheduled_at)s, %(unique_key)s ) ON CONFLICT (unique_key) WHERE unique_key IS NOT NULL AND state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed') DO UPDATE SET state = "chancy_jobs".state RETURNING id;

BEGIN
SAVEPOINT <auto>
DELETE FROM "chancy_workers" WHERE expires_at < NOW()

INSERT INTO "chancy_workers" (worker_id, last_seen, expires_at, tags, queues) VALUES ( %(worker_id)s, NOW(), NOW() + INTERVAL '90 seconds', %(tags)s, %(queues)s ) ON CONFLICT (worker_id) DO UPDATE SET last_seen = NOW(), expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '90 seconds', tags = EXCLUDED.tags, queues = EXCLUDED.queues
RELEASE SAVEPOINT
COMMIT
COMMIT
BEGIN

WITH selected_jobs AS ( SELECT id FROM "chancy_jobs" WHERE queue = %(queue)s AND (state = 'pending' OR state = 'retrying') AND attempts < max_attempts AND (scheduled_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC LIMIT %(maximum_jobs_to_fetch)s FOR UPDATE OF "chancy_jobs" SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "chancy_jobs" SET started_at = NOW(), state = 'running', claim_id = gen_random_uuid(), taken_by = %(worker_id)s FROM selected_jobs WHERE "chancy_jobs".id = selected_jobs.id RETURNING "chancy_jobs".*
COMMIT
